prompt:
Image 1 is the floor plan of a room seen from above: its bottom edge is the front wall, its top edge the back wall, its left edge the left wall and its right edge the right wall. Image 2 is the front view of the same room (the establishing view), taken from the centre of the front wall facing the back wall. Generate one photorealistic cinematic still of this same room, empty of people, from a new camera position: the left-side view: the camera stands at the centre of the right wall, at eye level, facing the left wall, so the back wall is at the right edge of the frame and the front wall at its left edge. Turn the camera for real: this view must not show the back wall's furniture head-on unless it is the wall being faced. Keep every wall, door, window, piece of furniture, material, colour and light exactly as Image 1 and Image 2 show them, seen from this new side; the room layout and furniture placement exactly match Image 1. Location: INT. SU YAQING'S DINING AREA. The elegant dining area of the same contemporary penthouse. A rectangular white marble dining table stands in the middle of the room, running from the left wall towards the right wall, with upholstered grey chairs around it. On the table are a glass vase of white daisies and a bottle of red wine. Left wall: a large window with sheer curtains, the main light source, casting daylight across the table from the left; one chair stands at the window end of the table. Back wall: a low walnut sideboard with decanters and a large framed print. Right wall: an open archway back to the living room, the way in. Front wall, behind the camera: a tall plant and a wine cabinet. A brass linear pendant lamp hangs over the table.

Avoid: people, readable text, logos, watermark, any door or window the description does not name.
